grade.answer_reason: It says yes and cites Corvane gateway 2.3's 5,000-part limit from the docs read 2026-05-30. It counts 7,680 parts at 8 MiB and recommends 16 or 64 MiB, which fall within the 8–512 MiB range, by changing CHUNK_MB in scripts/upload.sh. It also says to check the limit against the deployed version.
